featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Khadke
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi! 👋 I am Jayesh’s 11 yrs old daughter and I am very excited to be sharing this review!
We went to Bata shoe store 👟 at Vile Parle East and I must say that  it is an amazing and very high quality store with a large variety of amazing products, each with their own uses (workout, running, walking etc.) My family and I bought 4 pairs of shoes; 1 for my mom, 1 for my 6 yr old bro and 2 for me (none for my dad😜(he didn’t want, or need any)). For one of my pairs, there was a discount of 60%! These shoes fit me perfectly but we were hoping for something a bit bigger so that they will fit me in the future. Unfortunately, they didn’t have a bigger size and, since I liked those shoes a lot, we decided to buy the slightly small shoes and we left the store. Around 30-40 minutes later, we got a call from the store (We had given them our phone number) saying that they had found a bigger size in the same design! Can you believe it?! The employees decided to look for a bigger pair of shoes just for our satisfaction! So then we went back to the store, which didn’t take long because we were still out shopping, and traded the smaller shoes in for the bigger ones! In conclusion, the shoes all had reasonable prices and were certainly worth it. This shoe store is an awesome shoe store with great shoes and kind employees! Unfortunately, my family and I don’t live in India (we live in the Netherlands 🇳🇱 ), even though we are from India 🇮🇳 and we have family in India who we are currently visiting, so we won’t be able to come to this store a lot. That is why I, an 11 yr old girl, have taken the time to write this review on my dad’s phone. Thank you so much Bata shoe store for your amazing shoes and service!!!

featured_reviews.name: Pratiksha Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointment with the experience I had at your Andheri East branch on Thursday, 26th June.

According to your official website, the store’s closing time is listed as 9:30 PM. Based on this information, I made the effort to travel from quite a distance to visit your showroom to purchase a pair of sandals. I arrived at the store by 8:55 PM, well within operating hours, but was surprised to find the shutter already half closed.

I saw two staff members inside (one male and one female), and when I knocked and asked if I could enter, the female staff member refused to let me in, despite me pointing out that it was still not closing time. She simply ignored my request.

This was extremely disappointing and reflects poorly on your customer service standards. I kindly request you to look into this matter and ensure that store staff follow the stated opening and closing hours properly, so other customers don’t face the same inconvenience.

featured_reviews.name: Soham Raskar
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is a Great place to shop for shoes. I've got mine recently. The store is very neat and tidy. They offer a wide range of footwear as well as sport jackets, jerseys for men, women and kids. The store looks flashy in style and it's clearly visible from outside. The best part about the store is that the staff is very kind and helpful.they also have special offers on some footwears which also saves our pockets!
I would totally recommend checking out the store if you are searching for a nice pair of shoes!

featured_reviews.name: Sameer Chaturvedi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sales team was really helpful, i took my own sweet time to finalize, as i was picking up for my dad, had very specific features i was looking in the footwear.

Plus there was a size issue in one of the pairs i picked up, was exchanged hassle free, fast.

I was helped by the young lady there, great sales person.

Been to your store thrice Almost a month now ur AC is not working we are not able to bear the heat for 10 mins as customer it sad to see how ur staff is working in the extreme heat inside from so many days u din even provide them a fan it’s disheartening to see such a work place treat them well

featured_reviews.review_text: Timing of store is mentioned 9:30 but they close by 8:30/8:45 , whenever I go there is size or else colour options ( if they have color then they don't have size ) every time the thing repeats

featured_reviews.name: Avinash Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: What a brilliant customer service by Bata staff. One week ago I brought a pair of rainy shoes for myself from this store, shoes looks so good but after using whole day I realized the right shoes is defective, I am feeling pain in my right leg while wearing this shoes. NEXT day I visited the branch and complained about this. I asked for the replacement. Bata staff was so humbled he asked for the bill and he immediately asking any questions take my request for the change. He asked me to wait for 3 days. I called on 3rd day about my shoes. They told me to visit the showroom and can take any shoes with the exchange. Next day I visited early morning and finally they gave me a fresh new pair of shoes. I am so impressed by the staff and Bata. Thank you so much.

featured_reviews.name: Arvind Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: I had been to this store on 4th Feb 2026 as I wanted to buy a shoe for a function the next day. The shoe i liked didn't have the size 11 in brown colour. They had it in black. Mr. Dinesh offered to get it delivered to my place if I placed the order with them. But since I wanted it urgently Dinesh and his colleague went out of their way and started calling up nearby Bata stores to check if they had it in stock and ultimately could find it at a store in Borivali. I went later and picked it up from the borivali store. I sincerely appreciated this gesture of theirs. I want Bata company to take note of this. Such staff should be rewarded as they are the real assets of the company

featured_reviews.name: Arpit SHARMA-RM
featured_reviews.review_text: Wow what a manager! Very helpful staff. I could not get one pair of shoes here but they have got it arranged for me on an immediate basis. Variety is hug at the store. If your are here to buy a footwear, this store is not going to disappoint you at any cost.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Not many people know this but Bata is a Canadian based company. Most people think it is Indian.

Decent collection of shoes for both men and women. The quality of shoes are good. We bought two pairs of “mojdi” (traditional shoes). Glad they were not made of leather. The rubber is soft and was comfortable to wear for a long time.

The salesman was not pushy and was courteous.
